Hey there friendo! Do you like Linux? You do? Great!

Do you ever wish the Linux GUI was as polished and consistent and refined as that on the Mac? You do?! Awesome, I have just the thing for you!

Agora Desktop is an effort to make a Mac-like Desktop Environment for Linux and the BSDs using agentic coding. I know, I know, boo, hiss, but it's getting good results, having re-implemented most of Cocoa and its own window server.

Follow this account for more!

#Linux #FreeBSD #programming #design
